chunks: And whatever is in it from Muhammad ibn Adhafar, I have narrated it from my father, and from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah be pleased with them - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, and Al-Himyari together, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi', from Muhammad ibn Adhafar Al-Sayrafi.

key_terms.الصَّيْرَفِيُّ: Al-Sayrafi, a nisba indicating profession or origin
key_terms.سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Sa'd ibn Abdullah, a key narrator
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَذَافَرَ: Muhammad ibn Adhafar, a prominent narrator

ai.seo_question: Who are the narrators in the chain for Muhammad ibn Adhafar's hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq provides a detailed isnad (transmission chain) to authenticate the narrations of Muhammad ibn Adhafar Al-Sayrafi, linking them through his father, Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Hasan, and other prominent figures like Al-Humayri and Sa'd ibn Abdullah. This rigorous verification underscores the reliability of the transmission from the Imams, a hallmark of Shia hadith scholarship that emphasizes the continuity and trustworthiness of the chain of narrators (thiqa) to preserve the authenticity of religious teachings.
